title: Deep-sea panorama (scrolling)
section: Second round: Acts I and II
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
Open deep water seen square-on for the moon-boat ride: dark teal fading to near-black below, soft shafts of light from the surface above, a low line of distant rock silhouettes along the lower third, faint drifting fish. Match grotto-backcloth. A painted theatre backcloth seen square-on, full bleed to every edge, scene painting in the manner of Georges Méliès' 1903 film Le Royaume des fées; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 slightly out of register; faint film grain; no lettering. The left and right edges must join seamlessly when the cloth is repeated side by side.
Requested final aspect ratio 2560:1440. Opaque full-bleed scene; paint right to every boundary.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark.
